title: HELIX Terminology: Student Status
description: Standard lifecycle statuses for a student at an institution. Used by the Student resource 'status' attribute.

codes.definition: Person has expressed interest but has not applied
Person has submitted an application for admission
Application accepted; student has not yet enrolled
Student is actively registered in courses for a current or future term
Student has an approved leave and intends to return
Student has voluntarily or administratively separated from the institution
Student has been conferred a degree, certificate, or credential
Student is deceased. Record retained for historical and compliance purposes.
